sentences.text:
Heard Mr. Arbind Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Yogendra Kumar,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 498 of 2018,
dated 31.03.2018 for the offences punishable under Sections 354, 376, 511 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections  of the POCSO Act, 2012.

3. According to prosecution case, this petitioner with the intention to commit rape of the daughter of the complainant entered into the house of the complainant and tried to outrage the modesty of the daughter of the complainant and on hulla he anyhow managed to escape.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.58218 of 2023(3)
dt.19-10-2023 petitioner has clean antecedent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.
He further submits that the allegation as alleged in the complaint petition is false and fabricated and the petitioner has not committed any offences as alleged in the complaint petition.

5. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail of the Siyaram Singh @ Siyaram Sharma vs The State Of Bihar on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191681727/
1 petitioner and submits that from perusal of the complaint petition and S.A. of the complainant it appears that the petitioner has committed wrong with the daughter of the complainant and the age of the daughter of the complainant was 15 years at the time of the occurrence.
6.

entities.text: Siyaram Singh @ Siyaram Sharma vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, I am not inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner in connection with Complaint Case No. 498 of 2018 pending in the court of Exclusive Special Judge POCSO-cum- Additional Sessions Judge-VII, Gaya.
